name: Saunf
kitchenUse: Chewed after meals, or saunf tea (a teaspoon steeped in hot water).

typicalUse.note: Classical texts differ on whether fennel is cooling or warming, so virya is left unrecorded.

cautions.note: Do not give fennel oil or concentrated fennel preparations to babies.
Contains mildly estrogen-like compounds; avoid concentrated use with hormone-sensitive conditions.
Culinary amounts are fine; avoid concentrated preparations.

evidence.summary: A few small human studies on bloating and menstrual cramps. Not established as a treatment.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
